candidate: Rejected nominal controls retained as factual action history after native safety filtering
candidate_claim_not_yet_established: A policy limited to submitting legal bounded nominal controls can induce native safety overrides whose incorrectly recorded history causes later acceptance of physically dangerous controls; correcting executed-action feedback removes that pathway.
distinction_from_previous_candidates: This concerns past factual action attribution after an actual filter intervention, not current-request saturation aliases, task Goal replacement or speculative branch cache ownership.

latent_cbf.finding: The inspected native controller appends nominal controls to history, then may return a different filtered control for execution. Later RSSM observation updates use the unchanged nominal history. Time alignment is correct; action identity is conditionally wrong after a nontrivial correction.
latent_cbf.limits: No checkpoint posterior, actual intervention frequency, unsafe acceptance, physical violation or utility effect has been measured. Matched weights and normalization assets were not found in the previously checked official channels.

unisafe.finding: Both inspected IsaacLab entry points pass filtered actions into subsequent belief updates. The quantitative path's in-place action replacement also updates the policy history because its returned tuple and output dictionary share the action tensor.
unisafe.decision: This source path is a counterexample to generalizing the nominal-history defect. No defect was manufactured by replacing its correct feedback.
unisafe.limits: Source-only, not numerical task reproduction or proof of all safety properties. The quantitative script references a config absent from the fixed tree.

resource_check.public_pretrained_resource: The official UNISafe IsaacLab README links a world-model/filter archive; the public Google Drive file metadata returned HTTP200 with title pretrained_models.zip. Archive contents, checkpoint compatibility and native Clean are not verified.

dubins_branch.finding: The checked README describes data generation and training. Its complete tree contains no .pt/.pth/.ckpt/.safetensors bundle; three numerical reachability arrays are not pretrained learned-world-model weights. The IsaacLab archive cannot be assumed to match Dubins.
dubins_branch.limits: Only this branch's README/tree were checked. This is not proof that no compatible weights exist elsewhere.

resource_check.decision: No installation, checkpoint download or unrelated Clean panel is justified for the excluded UNISafe feedback operation. Preserve the source and resource links for a materially different hypothesis.

primary_literature_review.title: A Unified Framework for the Study of Anti-Windup Designs
primary_literature_review.scope: 1993 technical report / 1994 Automatica paper, focused reading of section3.7 and override context by independent reviewer.
primary_literature_review.finding: Controller output differing from actual plant input can corrupt an observer; using the actual input is an existing correction principle. Override/substitution is included, not only actuator saturation.
primary_literature_review.limit: This establishes conceptual overlap, not the empirical exploitability of a learned latent safety filter.

primary_literature_review.title: Safe Reinforcement Learning via Shielding under Partial Observability
primary_literature_review.finding: Belief updates depend on action-observation history and safe actions must preserve permitted successor beliefs. Correct action attribution is already part of the safety contract.
primary_literature_review.limit: Not a demonstrated adversarial nominal-history attack on the present code.

primary_literature_review.title: How to Train Your Latent Control Barrier Function
primary_literature_review.scope: Section4, focused independent review in addition to the earlier abstract-only resource audit.
primary_literature_review.finding: Safety-policy-only training may misestimate nominal-policy actions. A history-feedback claim must separate its effect from ordinary critic support mismatch.
primary_literature_review.limit: No local reproduction of the authors' learned models.

primary_literature_review.title: When World Models Lie: Adaptive Safety Analysis Under Wrong Imaginations
primary_literature_review.scope: SectionIV, Algorithm1 and relevant experimental/limitations text; no code or experiment reproduction.
primary_literature_review.finding: Prediction-versus-observation-inferred latent residuals already support adaptive pessimistic safety evaluation. Such a posterior is not independent physical ground truth. Algorithm1 does not explicitly spell out recomputation for the executed action after filtering; this is insufficient to infer an implementation bug.
primary_literature_review.limit: Neither ordinary residual pessimism nor executed-action feedback is established as a new defense here.

minimum_decisive_task_test_not_run.first_gate: A matching pretrained bundle, competent native Clean and naturally occurring nontrivial filter corrections are required before attributing any task effect.
minimum_decisive_task_test_not_run.paired_history_test: At one preselected corrected transition, hold actual observations, applied history, current nominal proposal, model weights and randomness fixed. Compare original nominal-recorded history with actual-applied history, preserving timing and normalization. First test posterior and filter acceptance effects.
minimum_decisive_task_test_not_run.actual_utility_test: Only with a signal, replay the same predeclared nominal policy from matched complete initial states under original and corrected feedback. Measure real physical constraint violations, success and return. Compare a competent feedback-correct safety filter; neither latent distance nor lower safety scores count as harm.
stop_conditions: Native feedback already uses the executed action.
Observation updates eliminate the proposed history effect.
Feedback correction leaves the same physical violation and no selective causal effect.
The effect requires direct history or sensor writes outside nominal-policy permissions.
The remaining contribution is only a conventional observer bug and conventional repair.

fixture.limit: Both fixture controls are strictly within the native bounds, so final clipping would preserve them. No physical environment is executed. In general the correct feedback must come after executor clipping; missing real ac_max files prevent assuming every filtered return equals the applied control.

cpu_route_reproduction.scope: Original compute_action/reset methods with recording stubs and synthetic observations. The critic forces one replacement; no learned-model output or physical outcome is measured.

go_no_go.go: Preserve the specific native feedback defect, correctly handled UNISafe counterexample, source assets and direct prior-art boundary.
go_no_go.no_go: No new task-harm claim, universal WM-security mechanism or paper-ready novelty. Do not train a new model to turn this source issue into an apparent new contribution.

activity.network_scope: Primary papers, official GitHub source/tree metadata and the public checkpoint-link metadata only. No credential access.
